what.text: This page follows refugees from Azerbaijan living in Armenia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 115346 Azerbaijani refugees in Armenia, 88.1% of all refugees from Azerbaijan.
Armenia is by far the largest host, followed by Germany, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh) territory in Azerbaijan from 1991 to 1994 and in many later years, most recently from 2020 to 2023 with the Republic of Artsakh.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Azerbaijan in 1993 and 1995.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 300000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 328000, at the end of 1993.
It then fell to a low in 2015 and rose again in the following years.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Armenia.
These are year-end totals for Armenia only, reported to UNHCR.
